services.name: Individual Session
services.fullDescription: Emotional distress often signals unacknowledged needs. In this collaborative space, we gently explore physical sensations, emotional triggers, and personalized somatic grounding techniques at your pace.
services.shortDescription: One-to-one counselling for individuals seeking support with emotional well-being, anxiety, relationships, life transitions, and personal growth.

services.name: Personal Concerns & Self-Compassion
services.fullDescription: Therapy provides an unhurried mirror to untangle who you are from who you were told you needed to be. Focus on gentle internal validation and healthy boundary development.
services.shortDescription: Untangling perfectionism, imposter syndrome, decision paralysis, and self-esteem dread.

services.name: Students Session
services.fullDescription: A safe and supportive space to talk about academic pressure, exam stress, self-doubt, motivation, friendships, relationships, emotional challenges, adjustment, and other concerns that may arise during student life.
services.shortDescription: I offer one-to-one counselling for undergraduate (UG) and postgraduate (PG) students, supporting concerns such as academic stress, career uncertainty, relationships, self-doubt, emotional challenges, and adjustment.

services.name: Student & Young Adult Support
services.fullDescription: Dedicated holding space for students and young professionals navigating high expectations, exam burnout, family separation, and emerging adulthood.
services.shortDescription: Support for college pressure, identity formation, career anxiety, and independence transitions.

services.name: Life Challenges & Phase Transitions
services.fullDescription: When life takes an unforeseen turn, having steady therapeutic accompaniment helps process grief, rebuild emotional anchors, and step forward with restored confidence.
services.shortDescription: Grief, major career shifts, relocation adjustment, and unexpected lifecycle disruptions.

sessionSteps.title: Connecting & Understanding
sessionSteps.description: The first phase is about creating a safe, comfortable space and understanding what brings you to therapy. We explore your concerns, experiences, emotions, relationships, and what you hope to work towards.

sessionSteps.title: Exploring & Becoming Aware
sessionSteps.description: Together, we gently explore patterns, emotions, beliefs, relationships, and coping responses. This phase is about developing a deeper understanding of yourself and what may be influencing your present experiences.

sessionSteps.title: Working Through & Building Skills
sessionSteps.description: As we understand your experiences better, therapy focuses on working through what feels difficult and developing healthier ways of coping, emotional regulation, self-awareness, communication, and decision-making.

sessionSteps.title: Growth & Integration
sessionSteps.description: The focus gradually shifts towards applying what you have explored in therapy to everyday life. You may begin to notice changes in how you respond to yourself, others, and challenging situations.

sessionSteps.title: Reviewing & Moving Forward
sessionSteps.description: We reflect on your progress, the changes you have made, and the areas you may still want to work on. Depending on your needs, therapy may gradually reduce in frequency, come to an end, or continue with new goals.

sessionFormats.title: Individual Online Counselling
sessionFormats.description: Consult from your personal sanctuary via secure private link. Flexible, discreet, and gentle.

sessionFormats.title: Initial Discovery Call
sessionFormats.description: A gentle, low-pressure introduction to share your hopes, ask questions, and see if we are a good fit.

journeyEntries.heading: My first experience with professional psychological support.
journeyEntries.description: My first experience with professional psychological support introduced me to the importance of having a safe space to understand emotions, thoughts, and experiences. It sparked my curiosity about psychology and gradually shaped my desire to understand and support others.

journeyEntries.heading: Beginning my academic journey in Psychology.
journeyEntries.description: Beginning my undergraduate journey in Psychology gave me the opportunity to explore human behaviour, emotions, and mental health more deeply. What began as an interest gradually grew into a meaningful academic and professional direction.

journeyEntries.heading: Pursuing Counselling Psychology.
journeyEntries.description: Pursuing my M.Sc. in Counselling Psychology helped me move beyond theoretical learning into understanding the therapeutic process, client experiences, and the importance of creating a safe, non-judgmental space.

journeyEntries.heading: Growing as a Counselling Psychologist and building my practice.
journeyEntries.description: Today, I continue to grow as a Counselling Psychologist through clinical practice, supervision, learning, and working with diverse client experiences. I am also building my own practice with the intention of making psychological support more accessible, meaningful, and client-centered.

feedback.feedback:
I’m really glad I found you . I’ve had some not so great experiences before in therapy ..so being able to feel comfortable and actually open up in therapy means a lot to me. 
I find you very understanding, empathetic and patient. In the beginning I found it difficult to open up and talk about what I was feeling but I never felt pressured to do so. You encouraged me to sit with my feelings and understand them instead of avoiding them which I think has been an important part of my progress. I also really like how you notice the things I don’t necessarily say out loud. Sometimes you pick up on things that I struggle to express myself and that makes me feel understood. I also like that you give me the space to process things at my own pace while still helping me when I need it.i feel like I’ve become more comfortable expressing things that I would usually keep to myself and I think the non-judgmental space you create has helped with that.
Overall I feel comfortable talking to you and I feel that the way you approach our sessions works well for me.

When I started therapy, I was kind of hesitant about whether therapy was for me or whether I should really be going for it. Still, I showed up, and my first session with you gave me confidence and a kind of ease, which helped me unpack more and get to know a bit of myself. I was able to acknowledge some parts of me which I knew existed, but I was unable to see them or even pushed myself away from those parts.

Even though sometimes I knew that I should be doing something, I didn't push myself to do those things or actually start them, such as playing badminton, which I kind of like. Your words gave me a bit of courage to actually start something and helped me trust myself a bit more. That made me think about the experiences I gained instead of being stuck in a loop with the past.

I am at ease speaking with you, and I had a safe space with you to talk about things more clearly. It helped me understand that I can view the world a bit more widely than just sticking to a narrow view. I am very much happy about it, and a great thank you for it.

Hi, I just wanted to share some feedback after our sessions.
Thank you for listening and creating a space where I felt comfortable opening up.
Our conversations have helped me understand myself better and reflect on things differently.
I really appreciate your patience, empathy, and the way you guided me without judgment.
While I know I still have a long way to go, I can already see positive changes in how I think and handle my emotions.
Thank you for your support, it truly means a lot to me.

You helped me a lot and I'm working forward with lots of happiness and a peaceful mind just because of your sessions.
I have a lots of gratitude for you,  Appreciating you for being helpful to me at my lowest.

It was really very relieving each time I had a session with you. Something that helped me the most is the way you asked questions. It made me learn and unlearn many things about my own self.
I guess I'm pretty self aware and being on therapy with self awareness itself is a bit difficult but you really helped me understand more about what reality is. You gave me different perspectives to think.
Also the coping mechanisms that you wanted me to follow worked pretty well than I expected.
I realised it's power only after being consistent on it.
And on the whole, it was so helpful and made me feel really better. Now I'm able to handle or cope with things mainly coz of all those sessions.
Thank you so much for that.
And for a person like me, it's so hard to even trust and continue visiting a general physician and in that case, I even suggested my friends to consult you. That is how much I was happy with your sessions.

noticeBox.title: Important Information Before Booking
noticeBox.message:
1. Video must remain on  throughout the session. Audio-only or chat-based sessions are not offered.
2. You may briefly share your concern with the psychologist before booking your session.
3. Payment must be completed in advance to confirm your appointment. The payment QR code/scanner will be shared with you via WhatsApp or email.
4. Your session will be confirmed only after the payment has been received.
5. The Google Meet link will be shared with you via WhatsApp  or email after payment confirmation.
6. The informed consent form will be shared with you via email after payment confirmation. Please read and complete the form before your scheduled session.
7. A sliding-scale fee option may be available depending on individual circumstances. This can be discussed with the psychologist before payment and booking confirmation.
8. Rescheduling is permitted only when requested at least 24 hours in advance.
9.Cancellations made within 24 hours of the scheduled session are non-refundable.
10. If you arrive late, the session will still end at the originally scheduled time.
11. Please ensure that you have a stable internet connection, a private and comfortable space, and a device with a working camera and microphone for your session.

websiteAbout.name: Aswathy Jeyarajasekar
websiteAbout.title: Counselling Psychologist
websiteAbout.fullBio:
I hold a B.Sc. in Psychology and an M.Sc. in Counselling Psychology, along with intensive training in Learning Disabilities.

As a Counselling Psychologist, I take a Client-Centred approach, focusing on creating a safe, compassionate, and non-judgmental space where you can feel heard and understood.

My practice is centred around helping individuals explore their emotions, develop deeper self-understanding, navigate life’s challenges, and work towards meaningful personal growth. I believe therapy is a collaborative process, where your experiences, needs, and pace remain at the heart of the work.
websiteAbout.shortIntro: Hi, I’m Aswathy, a Counselling Psychologist. I believe therapy is a space where you can feel heard, understood, and accepted without judgment. My goal is to create a safe and comfortable environment where you can openly explore your thoughts, emotions, relationships, and life experiences.
